Atlanta Multi-Trade Home Repair

You're looking for a reliable contractor in Atlanta to handle multiple home repair trades, and Build Heritage is here to help. On this site, you can get a free, written, and itemized quote for your home repair needs, and our team will respond within one business day.

How it Works for Atlanta Homeowners

We serve the metro Atlanta area, including cities like Marietta, Alpharetta, and Roswell. Our team of experts can handle 8 different trades, including painting, drywall, flooring, and roofing. We'll work with you to understand your needs and provide a detailed quote for the work. You can expect transparent pricing and a clear breakdown of the costs involved.

What You Get and What it Costs

Our 2026 cost guide, updated in August 2026, provides ranges for common home repair projects, such as full roof replacement ($9,000-$20,000) and whole-home interior repaint ($3,000-$8,000). We recommend holding back 10-15% on top of a quote for hidden issues. As a licensed and insured contractor in Georgia, you can trust that our work will be done to a high standard.

FAQ

What areas do you serve? We serve the metro Atlanta area, including cities like Atlanta, Marietta, Alpharetta, and Roswell. How do I get a quote? You can contact us at info@buildheritage.org or use the quote form on our site. What trades do you offer? We offer 8 trades, including packing & moving, painting, drywall, flooring & vinyl, framing, doors, window & door trim, and roofing & tiles.

Get your free quote today
